Water Prices, Annual: Potable Water Price For Domestic Users, 0-40 Cubic Metres
column4: Potable water for domestic use are supplied to premises used exclusively for residential purposes.  This includes residential premises approved for use as home offices under the Home Office Scheme.  Properties where any part of the premises is used for or in connection with any trade, business, or profession, or as a hotel, serviced apartment, boarding house, hostel, school, place of worship, or mess do not qualify as domestic use.
From 1 July 1997, Water Conservation Tax was imposed on Potable Water.
From 1 July 2017, the Sanitary Appliance Fee (Dollar Per Fitting) was combined with the Waterborne Fee into a single, volume-based fee.  The Waterborne Fee was renamed to Waterborne Tax in 2023.
For the calculation of total price, the Sanitary Appliance Fee is converted to its volumetric equivalent.
